tool_config.description: Returns the free times for a showing of one apartment with our leasing agent. Call it when you are ready to offer times, after the contact details. Read the tekst values word for word, at most three, and ask which one works. You never know the schedule yourself — never name a time that did not come from this result. If the caller named a day, pass that date in data_s.

obyavlenie_id.description: The apartment code: tw-3c, tw-6a, sw-2b, sw-5d, kg-1r or kg-4f.

data_s.description: Only if the caller named a day: that date as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from the calendar. Leave it out otherwise.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
